## Architecture

- [001\. Keep one monorepo for every stack](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/001-single-monorepo/index.md>)
- [002\. Modules are removable as whole slices](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/002-modules-are-removable-slices/index.md>)
- [003\. Every project documents itself](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/003-every-project-documents-itself/index.md>)
- [004\. One shared domain model serves streaming and storage](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/004-one-shared-domain-model/index.md>)
- [005\. Development infrastructure starts with the app that needs it](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/005-dev-infra-starts-with-the-app/index.md>)
- [006\. The whole system runs on one machine](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/006-the-whole-system-runs-on-one-machine/index.md>)
- [007\. One shared identity provider serves every authenticated surface](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/007-one-shared-identity-provider/index.md>)
- [008\. Real secrets are encrypted; only dev defaults are committed](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/008-secrets-never-in-plaintext/index.md>)
- [009\. Every example runs and is tested, or it is removed](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/009-examples-must-run-and-be-tested/index.md>)
- [010\. The unit validated is the unit that ships](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/010-the-unit-validated-is-the-unit-that-ships/index.md>)
- [011\. The development environment is a versioned artifact](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/011-the-development-environment-is-a-versioned-artifact/index.md>)
- [012\. Validation runs against real services, not substitutes](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/012-validation-runs-against-real-services/index.md>)
- [013\. Services prove who they are at every boundary](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/013-services-prove-who-they-are-at-every-boundary/index.md>)
- [014\. The gate that refuses a change is defined once](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/014-the-gate-is-defined-once-and-runs-everywhere/index.md>)
- [015\. A change answers for what it caused; the state of the world is reviewed on a cadence](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/015-a-change-answers-for-what-it-caused/index.md>)
- [016\. The system observes itself; its operational data never leaves it](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/016-the-system-observes-itself-internally/index.md>)
- [017\. Shared concepts change only in ways that keep readers working](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/017-shared-concepts-change-only-compatibly/index.md>)
- [018\. Settings arrive at startup through one channel and fail loudly](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/018-settings-arrive-at-startup-through-one-channel/index.md>)
- [019\. The system releases as one versioned whole](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/019-the-system-releases-as-one-versioned-whole/index.md>)
- [020\. Dependencies stay current by default; majors move by decision](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/020-dependencies-stay-current-by-default/index.md>)
- [021\. A new technology joins the system by recipe](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/021-a-new-technology-joins-by-recipe/index.md>)
- [022\. The codebase explains itself to the agents that change it](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/022-the-codebase-explains-itself-to-its-agents/index.md>)
- [023\. A storage schema changes only by recorded migration](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/023-storage-schema-changes-by-recorded-migration/index.md>)
- [024\. A validated release is promoted by a declared path](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/024-a-validated-release-is-promoted-by-a-declared-path/index.md>)
- [025\. Data has a stated lifetime that the system enforces](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/025-data-has-a-stated-lifetime/index.md>)
- [026\. The system can be brought back from a named snapshot](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/026-the-system-can-be-brought-back-from-a-named-snapshot/index.md>)
- [027\. Every stream carries a stated delivery guarantee](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/027-every-stream-carries-a-stated-delivery-guarantee/index.md>)
- [028\. Operational secret handling has a named owner and a rehearsed path](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/028-operational-secret-handling-has-a-named-owner/index.md>)
- [029\. What ships is signed, and its origin can be proven](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/029-shipped-artifacts-are-signed-and-their-origin-is-provable/index.md>)
- [030\. Interfaces between parts are verified, not assumed](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/030-interfaces-between-parts-are-verified-not-assumed/index.md>)
- [031\. Language and runtime versions have a declared support window](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/031-runtime-versions-have-a-declared-support-window/index.md>)
- [032\. Shared streams are named by a declared convention](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/032-shared-streams-are-named-by-a-declared-convention/index.md>)
- [033\. Shipped artifacts carry a contents inventory](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/033-shipped-artifacts-carry-a-contents-inventory/index.md>)
- [034\. Signals meet at one replaceable collection point](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/034-signals-meet-at-one-replaceable-collection-point/index.md>)
- [035\. Parts hand work to each other through a durable event log](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/035-parts-hand-work-through-a-durable-event-log/index.md>)
- [036\. The delivery plane is a named exception to the data boundary](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/036-the-delivery-plane-is-a-named-exception-to-the-data-boundary/index.md>)
- [037\. The system itself promises nothing about staying up](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/037-the-system-itself-promises-nothing-about-staying-up/index.md>)
- [038\. What a person may do is decided in one place, apart from who they are](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/038-what-a-person-may-do-is-decided-in-one-place-apart-from-who-they-are/index.md>)
- [039\. Data is protected where it travels and where it rests](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/039-data-is-protected-where-it-travels-and-where-it-rests/index.md>)
- [040\. The system raises its hand when it is broken](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/040-the-system-raises-its-hand-when-it-is-broken/index.md>)
- [041\. A failure of the running system has an owner and a rehearsed path](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/041-a-failure-of-the-running-system-has-an-owner-and-a-rehearsed-path/index.md>)
- [042\. Every dataset has an owner who answers for it](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/042-every-dataset-has-an-owner-who-answers-for-it/index.md>)
- [043\. AI-assisted review informs the two signatures](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/043-ai-assisted-review-informs-the-signatures-it-does-not-replace-them/index.md>)
- [044\. Every change carries two human signatures](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/044-every-change-carries-two-human-signatures/index.md>)
- [045\. Conventions are borrowed before they are invented](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/045-conventions-are-borrowed-before-they-are-invented/index.md>)
- [046\. The catalogue keeps its public contract](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/046-the-catalogue-keeps-its-public-contract/index.md>)
- [047\. One search store is the system of record](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/047-one-search-store-is-the-system-of-record/index.md>)
- [048\. Behaviour is proven against the reference](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/048-behaviour-is-proven-against-the-reference-before-it-is-accepted/index.md>)
- [049\. Every function and rule is traceable to a test](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/049-every-function-and-rule-is-traceable-to-a-test/index.md>)
- [050\. The system carries only what the catalogue needs](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/050-the-system-carries-only-what-the-catalogue-needs/index.md>)
- [051\. The conversion proceeds in specified increments](<https://aureliusenterprise.github.io/phase0-0.1-adopt-template/architecture/adr/051-the-conversion-proceeds-in-specified-increments/index.md>)
